info.description: AI powered bug tracking and QA management. All tenant routes live under /api/v1/orgs/{org_id}.

post.description:
Every other session ends (refresh tokens revoked, earlier access tokens refused). The response is a fresh token pair
for this device, issued after the change, so the person stays signed in here (D-055).

BugDraftOut.title: BugDraftOut
BugDraftOut.description: What the New bug form is filled with (the same fields as API-061); nothing is saved by asking for it.

BugUpdateIn.title: BugUpdateIn
BugUpdateIn.description:
Only the fields that are sent change. A field that is sent as null is cleared where that makes sense
(component, environment, release, assignee) and is a 422 otherwise.

CaseUpdateIn.title: CaseUpdateIn
CaseUpdateIn.description: Only the fields that are sent change. A case moves to another suite of the same project with `suite_id`.

invite_url.title: Invite Url
invite_url.description: Shown once. Send it yourself; no email is sent (D-011). The token is in the URL fragment (`/invite#<token>`), which browsers never send to a server.

InvitationTokenIn.title: InvitationTokenIn
InvitationTokenIn.description: The token goes in the body, never in the path or the query (BL-014, D-055).

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: Workspace address, lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens

reset_url.title: Reset Url
reset_url.description: Shown once. Send it to the person yourself; no email is sent (D-045). The token is in the URL fragment (`/reset-password#<token>`).

key.title: Key
key.description: 2 to 6 letters; stored in capitals and used in bug ids such as WEB-42

last_run_pass_rate.title: Last Run Pass Rate
last_run_pass_rate.description: Pass rate of the newest run, null when nothing is decided

pass_rate.title: Pass Rate
pass_rate.description: Pass rate of all runs together, null when nothing is decided

next_release.description: The soonest release that is not released yet

last_run_pass_rate.title: Last Run Pass Rate
last_run_pass_rate.description: Pass rate of the newest run, null when nothing is decided

pass_rate.title: Pass Rate
pass_rate.description: Pass rate of all runs together, null when nothing is decided

next_release.description: The soonest release that is not released yet

password.title: Password
password.description: At least 10 characters with a letter and a number

ReleaseUpdateIn.title: ReleaseUpdateIn
ReleaseUpdateIn.description:
Only the fields that are sent change. `target_date: null` clears the date. `status` only moves forward (planned, in progress,
released). The AI summary fields arrive with I-18; until then sending them is a 422.

new_password.title: New Password
new_password.description: At least 10 characters with a letter and a number

ResultUpdateIn.title: ResultUpdateIn
ResultUpdateIn.description: `failed_step_index` (from 0) and `actual_result` only go with `fail`; any other result clears them.

RunCountsOut.title: RunCountsOut
RunCountsOut.description: `pass` is a Python keyword, so the field is `pass_` here and `pass` in the JSON.

RunCreateIn.title: RunCreateIn
RunCreateIn.description: The cases of the run are every case of `suite_ids` plus every case of `case_ids`, each once.

RunUpdateIn.title: RunUpdateIn
RunUpdateIn.description: Only the fields that are sent change. `status: completed` ends the run (it cannot be reopened). `release_id: null` unlinks.

SavedViewFilters.title: SavedViewFilters
SavedViewFilters.description:
The stored filter set: the same keys as the list endpoint, plus a version number. Unknown keys are a 422.
When a stored filter changes meaning, add version 2 to the Literal and a reader that upgrades version 1 rows.

SourceRunOut.title: SourceRunOut
SourceRunOut.description: The test run a bug was filed from (I-07): shown as a link to the run.

StepIn.title: StepIn
StepIn.description: A step. Send the `id` of an existing step to keep it when steps are reordered; steps without one get a new id.

SuiteUpdateIn.title: SuiteUpdateIn
SuiteUpdateIn.description: Only the fields that are sent change. `component_id: null` clears the component.

TriageIn.title: TriageIn
TriageIn.description: Either an existing bug (`bug_id`, nothing else) or the fields of a bug that is not saved yet (`project_id` and `title` at least).
